summary: Embotelladora Andina S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting a material event: an interim dividend declared by its board on September 29, 2026, under authority granted by the April 16, 2026 regular shareholders meeting. Holders of Series A shares receive Ch$36.5 per share and Series B holders Ch$40.15 per share, payable October 29, 2026 against 2026 fiscal-year income, with the shareholders registry closing five business days before payment. No advisor, premium, or structural mechanics are disclosed. This is a routine capital distribution, not a special situation; watch for further interim dividends or year-end true-ups.
